summary.root_cause_text: Ops config change pointed payment_provider_url to internal://payments-v2 (provider migration), which is unreachable; the worker marked orders processed without payment.
recommended: Ask ops to validate that payments-v2 is reachable before retrying the migration.
Alert on payment provider failures, which were logged only at DEBUG.

events.text:
version: v1.3
payment_provider_url: internal://payments-v2
queue_max: 1000
worker_count: 1
sync_interval_s: 5
Revert to v1 to stop the loss.
payment_provider_url: 'internal://payments-v2' -> 'internal://payments-v1'. Confirmed: the service is now using the new value.
All business invariants green (health, payments, queue, worker, ledger, errors, latency).

root_causes: Ops config change pointed payment_provider_url to internal://payments-v2 (provider migration), which is unreachable; the worker marked orders processed without payment.
evidence: DEBUG payment: provider call failed: payment provider unreachable at internal://payments-v2 (412x)
recent_changes: 2 min ago payment_provider_url payments-v1 -> payments-v2 by ops
args.impact: Orders were processed without payment while v2 was configured. The alert showed 10 of 26 orders unpaid, worth total_sar 8009.11. The count kept growing during the investigation. reprocess_orders then paid 428 orders, with money_recovered total_sar 215220.1 (SAR 71676.1, USD 38278.4).
recommended_actions: Ask ops to validate that payments-v2 is reachable before retrying the migration.
Alert on payment provider failures, which were logged only at DEBUG.
args.summary: The provider migration config change to payments-v2 made payment calls fail silently, so orders were processed with no payment. I reverted the URL to payments-v1 and reprocessed all unpaid orders. All invariants are now green.
